hypothesis.work: Pack only referenced outer-role columns on the original full evaluation domain. Keep kernels, row masks, denominators, powers and global bucket unchanged.
hypothesis.time_removed: Estimate 0.3-1.5 seconds from the measured 6.123-second fullstack recursion window, predominantly by reducing capacity waits and enabling sibling overlap. FFT traffic alone is unlikely to remove even 0.3 seconds. Failure to improve is plausible because whole-node live state still exceeds the role arena.
hypothesis.success_bar: Positive matched whole-request change versus default; first fullstack pair was 0.9402 seconds slower. No benefit claimed before timing. Exact per-node peak <=11e9 bytes remains separate.

candidate_boundary.mapping: Authenticated (tree,column) deduplication, shared packed slab tree bases, per-mask packed slot offsets; row shifts and full domain unchanged. Scope/token/generation validation before each merged source run.
candidate_boundary.cost: Source-class and runtime agree on selected count, full-domain slab, twiddles, selected logs, full global bucket and retained metadata.
candidate_boundary.timing: Original separate FFT and row event spans; profile pair excluded from request medians.
